gloss: to start (an activity); to get involved in; to engage in

definitions.gloss: to start; to begin; to get involved in (an activity)
definitions.explanation: To begin engaging in an activity or field. Can be neutral but often carries a negative connotation when referring to undesirable activities.

definitions.gloss: to get one's hands dirty; to become involved in (wrongdoing)
definitions.explanation: To become implicated in or start participating in illegal, immoral, or undesirable activities.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}に{絵画|かいが}に{手|て}を{染|そ}めた。
examples.english: I started painting when I was young.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}に{演劇|えんげき}に{手|て}を{染|そ}めた。
examples.english: I got into theater during my student days.

examples.japanese: {政治|せいじ}に{手|て}を{染|そ}めてからもう{二十年|にじゅうねん}になる。
examples.english: It's been twenty years since I got into politics.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{犯罪|はんざい}に{手|て}を{染|そ}めてしまった。
その{世界|せかい}に{一度|いちど}{手|て}を{染|そ}めたら{抜|ぬ}けられない。
examples.english: Once you get involved in that world, you can't get out.

examples.japanese: {生活|せいかつ}に{困|こま}って{悪事|あくじ}に{手|て}を{染|そ}めてしまう{人|ひと}もいる。
examples.english: Some people end up getting involved in wrongdoing because they're struggling to make ends meet.

notes:
IDIOM STRUCTURE:
{手|て} (hand) + を + {染|そ}める (to dye)

Literally "to dye one's hands" - implies getting deeply involved in something, as if the activity has stained one's hands.

NUANCE:
- Can be neutral when referring to arts, hobbies, or professions
- Often negative when referring to illegal or immoral activities
- Suggests deep involvement, not superficial engagement
- The "dye" metaphor implies lasting involvement that's hard to wash away

GRAMMAR:
〜に{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to get involved in ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{犯罪|はんざい}に{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to get involved in crime
・{悪事|あくじ}に{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to engage in wrongdoing
・{政治|せいじ}に{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to get into politics
・{芸術|げいじゅつ}に{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to take up art

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{手|て}を{出|だ}す - to get involved in (also often negative)
・{首|くび}を{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む - to stick one's nose into
・{足|あし}を{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れる - to step into, to enter (a field)

REGISTER:
Neutral to literary. Common in written Japanese and dramatic contexts.
